data.headline: Product Consultant
data.about:
Multi-disciplined technologist and product specialist following a transition from QA, with 8 years of agency experience in software development as part of an integrated development team working on successful waterfall, V model and agile projects. 

Experienced at working with internal and external stakeholders at all levels (Client Stakeholders, Strategy, UX/CX, UI Design & Development teams etc) to identify and manage requirements through the full product/project life cycle.

Motivated employee who takes pleasure in working with all members of the team and working outside of his role to contribute to business success.

description.text:

Oversight of federation strategy with healthcare providers,

Roadmap management
